title: Odoo 17 sales order, 4 lines, Boxed layout
notes: Captured from Odoo 17.0 Community (commit dca5cd22d40f) printing through HTTP /report/pdf with a logged-in session; Odoo passed `--cookie-jar <temp file>` (session cookie), that pair is removed. Temp file names lose only their random part. Origin http://127.0.0.1:8069 rewritten to http://127.0.0.1:8765 (in the <base href> of the three HTML files). httpHeaders are the Cache-Control values Odoo sends; without them wkhtmltopdf 0.12.6 draws the header and footer before their web fonts load and their text is missing (see SOURCE.md). The files common to the five Odoo entries are in ../_shared/odoo17/www.
